marisol: FYI weekly health for Deckhand — quick surface of p95/p99 by route + model, streaming vs sync. Noticing a shift on a couple of sync routes.

jatin: saw that spike this morning, digging. attaching quick table. :mag_right:

jatin: ```
route               | model        | streaming p95/p99 | sync p95/p99
/chat/stream        | astral-13b   | 110ms / 210ms     | 210ms / 480ms
/chat/generate      | astral-13b   | 130ms / 260ms     | 260ms / 720ms
/embeddings/vector  | embed-lite   | 95ms  / 160ms     | 320ms / 690ms
/search/rerank       | bert-compact | 150ms / 300ms     | 420ms / 980ms
```

ellie: summary: streaming stays within SLOs at p99 for most routes, sync p99 on /search and /chat/generate > baseline — could be batching or KV cache miss. :thinking:

amanda: any customer impact? Deckhand worried about latency affecting QA automation runs. renewal talk in 6 weeks. :worried:

marisol: Deckhand reported flaky CI runs this AM, they correlated failures with longer sync tail on rerank. flagged as low-to-medium renewal risk if persists.

jatin: initial hypothesis: sporadic fallback to quantized variant on sync path under high concurrent sync traffic -> cold cache + suboptimal kernel. I can reproduce locally with their workload shape.

jatin: quick repro command I used: ```bash
./loadtest --concurrency 40 --route /search/rerank --seq 512 --model bert-compact --mode sync
```

ellie: ops suggestion: enable per-route prefix cache for rerank and reduce sync batch size to avoid queueing. also consider enabling streaming fallback for their bot-to-bot integrations (they're open to small API change).

marisol: action items:
- jatin: add a short-run canary with prefix cache on prod cluster for Deckhand (ETA EOD)
- ellie: draft note + small SDK snippet to propose streaming fallback to Deckhand (ETA tomorrow)
- amanda: reach out to customer to acknowledge and share mitigation plan (ETA today)

amanda: pinged Deckhand PM, they want transparency. set a 1pm sync to walk through numbers and our mitigation.

infra-bot: deploy Canary for tenant deckhand initiated by jatin at 3820043235

jatin: can confirm canary running, initial p99 on /search/rerank dropped from ~980ms to ~260ms with prefix cache enabled. will monitor. :thumbsup:

marisol: great — I'll update renewal tracker and note improvement. please drop a short summary after 24h so I can close the loop with Deckhand.

ellie: small SDK diff attached in the thread (see PR link) — adds `prefer_streaming: true` toggle and example fallback logic.

amanda: after the sync Deckhand asked for a post-mortem doc and whether we can add a health alert for sync tail > 500ms.

jatin: agree we should add alerting: rule suggestion -> if sync p99 > 500ms for 10min AND error rate < 1% then trigger paging to infra (to avoid noise during incidents). I'll open ticket.

marisol: thanks all. if the canary keeps stable, I'll mark as mitigated in account notes.

amanda: logging summary for customer sync: `p95_p99_surface_3820043210.csv` pushed to shared drive.

marisol: closing for now, will reopen if tails reappear. :v:
